objects.description: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) has used [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) to stop services prior to the execution of ransomware.(Citation: Symantec WastedLocker June 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) از [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) برای توقف خدمات قبل از اجرای باج‌افزار استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Symantec WastedLocker June 2020)
